The upgrade from `zizmor-action` v0.6.2 to v0.6.3 pulls in zizmor v1.30.0, which introduced the `self-repository` audit. It finds three existing reusable-workflow references using the older `./...` syntax:

- `.github/workflows/ci.yml:16`
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml:24`
- `.github/workflows/release-plz.yml:78`

They should use GitHub’s new self-repository syntax:

```yaml
uses: $/.github/workflows/ci-impl.yml

```

The three low-severity findings cause zizmor to exit with code 12, failing [the check](https://github.com/jdx/communique/actions/runs/34357139920/job/102484581124). This is a newly introduced audit, not a problem executing the upgraded action. [Zizmor’s documentation](https://docs.zizmor.sh/audits/#self-repository) confirms the audit was introduced in v1.30.0 and supports automatic fixes.
